name: Role Feature
summary: Ogryn Role Feature Bulwark While using a shield, you also gain advantage on saves against being shoved. Gun Lugger Your first ranged Ogryn weapon attack each turn deals +1d6 damage. Bone ’ead Once per short rest, when you or an ally within 10 ft fails a Wisdom or Intelligence saving throw against fear, psychic manipulation, confusion, or Suppression, you may use your reaction to let that creature reroll the save. Brute Your Brute damage becomes +1d8.
